description: R-16.7 golden: a hand-computed fused order across three domains, and the exact order demoteSupersededAndExpired must produce. memory:project/c is expired and must sink below every non-expired peer regardless of score; memory:project/b supersedes memory:project/a and must never rank below it. file:x carries neither flag and keeps its relative position. Expected order is hand-traced against the implementation's own documented algorithm (partition expired to the end, then reinsert each superseded entry immediately after its superseder), not copied from a test run.
